description: Provision a Google Cloud Sql SQLUser via Config Connector. Fields mirror the sql.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 SQLUser spec.

host.description: Immutable. The host the user can connect from. This is only supported for MySQL instances. Don't set this field for PostgreSQL instances. Can be an IP address. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

instanceRef.description: Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `SQLInstance` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

password.description:
The password for the user. Can be updated. For Postgres instances this is a Required field, unless type is set to
                either CLOUD_IAM_USER or CLOUD_IAM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT. Set exactly one of `value` (a literal) or `valueFrom` (a reference to a Secret key).

value.description: Value of the field. Cannot be used if 'valueFrom' is specified.

valueFrom.description: Source for the field's value. Cannot be used if 'value' is specified.

secretKeyRef.description: Reference to a value with the given key in the given Secret in the resource's namespace.

key.description: Key that identifies the value to be extracted.

name.description: Name of the Secret to extract a value from.

allowedFailedAttempts.description: Number of failed attempts allowed before the user get locked.

enableFailedAttemptsCheck.description: If true, the check that will lock user after too many failed login attempts will be enabled.

enablePasswordVerification.description: If true, the user must specify the current password before changing the password. This flag is supported only for MySQL.

passwordExpirationDuration.description: Password expiration duration with one week grace period.

locked.description: If true, user does not have login privileges.

passwordExpirationTime.description: Password expiration duration with one week grace period.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

type.description:
Immutable. The user type. It determines the method to authenticate the user during login.
                The default is the database's built-in user type. Flags include "BUILT_IN", "CLOUD_IAM_USER", or "CLOUD_IAM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT".

title: GCP Sql SQLUser
